title: The link surgery modules of 2-component L-space links
summary: In our earlier work, we studied the link surgery modules of two component L-space links. Therein, we computed two of the four idempotents of such modules. In this article, we use Koszul duality to give an alternate account of this proof, and also to extend it to compute the entire link surgery modules of such links, modulo a technical result which will be proven in a subsequent paper.
